newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends off lows, spread stays flat.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends off lows, spread stays flat.

text.p: Nearby white sugar futures closed slightly weaker in Tuesday's thin session but tandem movements across the board kept both the March/May spread and the spot white premium steady, traders said.

The spot March contract avoided even making an attempt to approach $300.00 resistance after its brief upward foray on Monday, although light mixed buying kept it above nearby support at $296.00 despite a quick visit to $295.10. "There's a little bit of support coming back into the market after this morning's dive," said one trader.
"I think people were thinking it might go through support but it held up."
March closed 80 cents lower at $297.10. May was at the same level, 60 cents down on the day. Overall volume amounted to 1,216 lots.
Traders said the flat nearby spread would probably deter buyers with non-urgent demand as they could hold off at least until the start of 1997.
The March white/raw premium narrowed slightly to around $69 and with the generally bearish sentiment in London, more selling is widely expected on the whites to drag it down further.
Paris futures ended mostly unchanged in a total volume of 606 lots. Both March and May were flat at $297.00.
